description: Fingerprint of the production (foundation) schema rebuilt from this repository: platform-prelude.sql, candidate.sql, baseline-supplement.sql and updates/*.sql in filename order. Produced by `pnpm db:foundation:replay -- --write` with database/foundation/fingerprint.sql. CI fails when the replay differs.

productionCheck.method: Read-only catalogue capture of production, same query formats. table_grants returns no row in production or in the replay (no table privileges for the API roles), so it is listed as matching without a fingerprint.
productionCheck.howToCompare: In the Supabase SQL editor (read-only), run `set search_path to "$user", public;` first, so pg_get_indexdef prints `extensions.gin_trgm_ops` as the replay does, then run database/foundation/fingerprint.sql unchanged and compare each row with categories below.

knownDifferences: Reference data is not fingerprinted. candidate.sql seeds posting-terms version posting-v2, which production does not hold: production has posting-v1 and posting-v3 (current since 20261109173012_posting_terms_v3.sql), and posting-v4 (published, not current) once 20261112122001_publish_posting_terms_v4.sql is applied.

schema_grants: production has 8 items (d397fed9c8bd9d4fc50ebdd777899d93) and the replay 7 (categories below). The extra production item is `internal supabase_auth_admin:USAGE`, which Supabase grants when the Auth "Before user created" hook is switched on; no repository file creates it (see replay/hosted-auth-hook-grants.sql).
